latestAction.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 752.

summary.text: This bill requires the Department of the Interior to study the feasibility of designating the Bay Area Ridge Trail as a national scenic trail. The trail extends approximately 550 miles in the San Francisco Bay Area of California. Interior must complete the feasibility study no later than three years after this bill's enactment.

title: To amend the National Trails System Act to direct the Secretary of the Interior to conduct a study on the feasibility of designating the Bay Area Ridge National Scenic Trail, and for other purposes.
